customers_say: Customers find this water purifier to be the best in the market with excellent performance and installation. They appreciate its premium appearance, with one customer noting its modern touch panel with LED indicators, and they like its taste and water quality, with one mentioning TDS levels below 100. However, reliability is a concern as multiple customers report units going completely dead within 24 hours of installation.

reviews.title: Nice product
reviews.body: The product was delivered on time, and the quality looks very good. Installation was fast and hassle-free. I am happy with the initial experience, and I hope the product will last long.

reviews.author: Lalit
reviews.title: Excellent Product with Great Performance and Premium Design!
reviews.body: I am extremely happy with my Native M2 Pro water purifier. The design is sleek and premium, the features are impressive, and the water dispensing is smooth and convenient.
